# @stapel/orders-react 0.1.0

Headless React flow pair for stapel-orders (contract >=0.1 <0.2) — business + state, zero visual opinion.
Built on @stapel/core: typed client + StapelApiError envelope, auth token refresh,
verification-403 interception, i18n engine, analytics facade, TanStack Query layer.

## The one right way (do this, the rest is a review/lint smell)
- No raw fetch/axios. The client is injected via <OrdersProvider>/StapelConfigProvider;
  every hook and flow already carries auth, refresh, and the error envelope.
- Render errors, never try/catch them: a flow's state carries FlowError{code,params};
  render `t(code, params)` and branch on `explainOrdersError(code)` remediation.
- Server state = the use* hooks (query layer); keys come only from ordersQueryKeys.
- User strings = i18n keys (registerOrdersI18n); never string literals.
- Sign-in UI = a headless flow component; copy it (shadcn-style) to restyle.

## Layers
api (typed client) · model (hooks, session) · flows (machines) · headless · i18n

## Documented flows (flows.json — canonical id, steps, endpoints)
- orders.cart: GET /orders/api/v1/cart/, POST /orders/api/v1/cart/lines/, PATCH /orders/api/v1/cart/lines/<int:line_id>/, DELETE /orders/api/v1/cart/lines/<int:line_id>/, DELETE /orders/api/v1/cart/
- orders.fulfilment: POST /orders/api/v1/orders/<int:order_id>/transition/
- orders.history: GET /orders/api/v1/orders/, GET /orders/api/v1/orders/<int:order_id>/, POST /orders/api/v1/orders/<int:order_id>/cancel/
- orders.purchase: POST /orders/api/v1/checkout/

## Operations (typed; use the named op, never a path string)
Request/response schema names are in manifest.json + the generated types.
Paths are relative to `/orders/api/v1/`.
- orders_cart_clear: DELETE /cart/
- orders_cart_lines_create: POST /cart/lines/
- orders_cart_lines_destroy: DELETE /cart/lines/{line_id}/
- orders_cart_lines_update: PATCH /cart/lines/{line_id}/
- orders_cart_retrieve: GET /cart/
- orders_checkout_create: POST /checkout/
- orders_orders_cancel: POST /orders/{order_id}/cancel/
- orders_orders_list: GET /orders/
- orders_orders_retrieve: GET /orders/{order_id}/
- orders_orders_transition: POST /orders/{order_id}/transition/

## Query hooks (server state; keys come only from the key factory)
- useAddToCart (mutation) → addLine : UseMutationResult< Cart, StapelApiError, AddToCartVariables >
- useCancelOrder (mutation) → cancelOrder : UseMutationResult< Order, StapelApiError, number >
- useCart (query) → cart : UseQueryResult<Cart, StapelApiError>
- useCheckout (mutation) → checkout : UseCheckoutResult
- useClearCart (mutation) → clearCart : UseMutationResult<Cart, StapelApiError, void>
- useOrder (query) → order : UseQueryResult<Order, StapelApiError>
- useRemoveCartLine (mutation) → removeLine : UseMutationResult< Cart, StapelApiError, number >
- useUpdateCartLine (mutation) → updateLine : UseMutationResult< Cart, StapelApiError, { readonly lineId: number; readonly quantity: number } >

## Other hooks (call shape; a REQUIRED option missing is a type error)
- useOrders(options?: UseOrdersOptions — 3 optional) → OrdersQueryResult
- useAddToCartButton(props: AddToCartProps — required { purchasableType: string; purchasableKey: string }, 3 optional) → AddToCartBag

## Errors (render t(code, params); UX from remediation)
54 keys (full catalog: manifest.json §errors). By remediation: fix_input 23 · retry 16 · wait_and_retry 6 · verify 5 · contact_support 2 · reauthenticate 2.
Param-bearing keys (interpolation slots matter):
- error.400.field.blank [400] → fix_input {field}
- error.400.field.does_not_exist [400] → fix_input {field}
- error.400.field.invalid [400] → fix_input {field}
- error.400.field.invalid_choice [400] → fix_input {field}
- error.400.field.max_length [400] → fix_input {field,max_length}
- error.400.field.max_value [400] → fix_input {field,max_value}
- error.400.field.min_length [400] → fix_input {field,min_length}
- error.400.field.min_value [400] → fix_input {field,min_value}
- error.400.field.null [400] → fix_input {field}
- error.400.field.required [400] → fix_input {field}
- error.400.field.unique [400] → fix_input {field}
- error.409.cart_too_many_lines [409] → fix_input {max}
- error.409.order_transition_invalid [409] → fix_input {from,to}
- error.429.rate_limit [429] → wait_and_retry {retry_after_minutes}

## Analytics events (typed; defineEvent → events.json, drift-gated)
- (no app defineEvent() in this pair — its analytic events are the
  auto-instrumented flow funnels below)

## Flow funnels (auto-instrumented: flow.<id>.<step> {phase})
- flow.orders.cart.<step> — 6 documented step(s)
- flow.orders.fulfilment.<step> — 2 documented step(s)
- flow.orders.history.<step> — 3 documented step(s)
- flow.orders.purchase.<step> — 4 documented step(s)

```tsx
// Typed event + tracked() click (the one right way; §3.1).
const planSelected = defineEvent({
  name: "pricing.plan.selected",
  description: "User picked a plan",
  props: { plan: prop.oneOf(["free", "pro", "team"], "Plan code") },
});
const { tracked } = useTracked();
<Button onClick={tracked(planSelected, { plan }, startCheckout)} />
// A click that STEPS a flow machine is already instrumented — mark it
// data-analytics="flow" instead; tracked() on top double-counts (§3.2).
```

## Test ids (src/testids.ts — fixed by the pair, never props)
add-to-cart · go-to-cart · cart-badge · page-cart · cart-line · cart-total · cart-empty · checkout-link · page-checkout · checkout-submit · page-orders · order-row · orders-load-more · page-order · order-cancel

## Browser flows (flows.json, stapel.flows/1; a member flow needs a signed-in session first)
- cart (any): A guest adds a listing to the cart and sees the line
- purchase (member): A member adds a listing, checks out and lands on the placed order

- orders.provider → <OrdersProvider> [default]  demo/Orders.demo.tsx
Each source file is the canonical usage snippet (open the default variant).

## Snippets
```tsx
// Error rendering + remediation branch (one pattern for every pair).
const r = explainOrdersError(err.code); // 'wait_and_retry' | 'verify' | ...
return <Alert action={r}>{t(err.code, err.params)}</Alert>;
```
